cohort: 141 pregnant women with IBD and 1119 pregnant women without IBD
finding: Pregnancy outcomes were comparable between women with IBD and women without IBD, although cesarean delivery rates were higher in the IBD group.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more frequent in patients with IBD (49/141 (34.8%) vs. 270/1119 (24.1%), p = 0.021).
